final_reason: V2 pass=3/15 + manual=13/15 @ best step=1500; matches BG-HS R1 floor; vocab 16K does not unlock surface chat-cap
lesson_implications: Lesson I confirmation — universe-brain-map domain anchor learning replicates across tokenizer (byte-256 BG-HS R1 ↔ BPE 16K BG-IG), but vocab axis alone does not unlock V2 chat-cap surface
honest_c3: corpus is BG-HT regenerated 6.79MB universe-brain-map (BG-HS R1 21.56MB original overwritten by BG-HT build) — spec called for 21MB but only 6.79MB available; honest reduction documented
BPE 16K vocab built on same 6.79MB corpus the model trained on — vocab pieces optimized for THIS distribution; out-of-corpus prompts may tokenize sub-optimally
V2 strict surface keyword overlap + particles + endings; cycle/persona-repeat penalty added (V3 surface) but embedding-similarity NOT implemented
domain_match counts ANY prompt where ANY mode (greedy/sample) hits ≥1 domain keyword — overcounts (BG-HS R1 13/15 was per-prompt-any not per-mode-all)
single seed=42; vocab/init randomness not isolated across multi-seed
persona prefix '[anima 우주뇌지도]' user-defined as single token = strong inductive bias toward universe-brain-map at inference
BG-HQ false-PASS at step 500 (V2 pass=8/10) was unmasked by manual review = persona prefix cycle; BG-IG manual_match counts substantively but cycle detector V3 still surface
outside-well 5 prompts (greeting/code/emotion/turn-format/capability) test generalization beyond universe-brain-map; their match count = generalization signal
BG-HT 6.79MB has aug=5x with limited semantic depth (per BG-HT honest_c3); compression bias toward this distribution may not reflect general Korean
no perplexity tracking on held-out non-corpus Korean; val_loss is in-distribution only
